notes.title: Pointblank (v2.0.0, The Snowy Update)
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3][p][b]Core Mechanic[/b][/p][p]Reworked the primary core mechanic. Your core has to be picked back up once shot. Positioning, where you shoot, and what you shoot is essential.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Augment System[/b]
A brand new augment system. Augments are now categorized into three unlockable pools. [/p][p]
Each run begins with a patching phase. Players select from a set of augments based on their unlocked pools. Patches occur at certain score milestones and become sparser as your score racks up.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Augments (20+ added)[/b]
Over 20 new augments have been implemented. Examples include:[/p][list][*][p][i]Ping, Fetch, Recall, Splash, [/i]and[i] Blink. [/i]The powers these augment grant range from buffs to entirely new mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Each augment introduces new interaction potential, counters, and helps you get higher scores.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Leaderboard System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Brand new global leaderboard system integrated with Steam. Compete with others and try to improve your ranking.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Combat and Enemy Changes[/h3][p][b]Full Enemy Rebalance[/b]
All enemy types have been adjusted to match the new augment system and pacing. Changes affect spawn rate, spawn distance, AI behavior, and projectile behavior.[/p][p][b]Enemy Types[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Rollers, Rushers, Screens[/i], and others have been added or reworked[/p][/*][*][p]Unique movement logic and interactions per type[/p][/*][*][p]Spawn pacing governed by an updated enemy spawning system that scales with difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance pass across all augment values, cooldowns, and enemies[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]System Overhauls[/h3][p][b]Performance Mode[/b]
Players can disable post-processing, particles, and other visual effects for smoother performance on lower-end systems or during recording/streaming.[/p][p][/p][p][b]UI and UX Revisions[/b][/p][list][*][p]Main menu visuals and transitions improved[/p][/*][*][p]Sound and click feedback added across UI[/p][/*][*][p]Settings menu toggles now persist correctly[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Restart logic now behaves correctly across all states[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu with ability to abandon mid-run[/p][/*][*][p]Discord Rich Presence updated to display score and patching status[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Developers Note[/h3][p]Thank you for playing the game, trying it, or even just having it in your library. I hope this update feels kinda fun and fresh, and I'm always welcome to any feedback, criticisms or ideas you may have: minidevsofficial@gmail.com[/p]
